## Side Quests

Not everything I build belongs to a course or a formal project. This page is for the things I make and try out of curiosity.

## RC Planes

### Gallery

My friend Suyash Prakash and I assembled three RC planes as a hobby: an F-22 Raptor, a trainer aircraft, and a 3D aerobatic plane.
